newsitem.title: UK: Lonrho plunges on profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Lonrho plunges on profit warning.

text.p: Shares in Lonrho Plc plunged 12 percent on Monday after the group issued a profit warning.
At 1326 GMT, the shares were down 19p to 138-1/2p.
The group said that its interim results could be down by a third from a year ago.

In a statement, Lonrho said the strength of sterling, poor precious metals prices, lower profits at Ashanti and moderate results in its African trading business will have a negative impact on the group's continuing businesses.
The trading statement, said one market maker, "doesn't give much detail," but the market's initial reaction, he added, may have been overdone.
